# 21.A.20 Compliance with the type-certification basis

# source: external/Part-21_EAR_Reg-748-2012_Nov-2025.pdf

21.A.201 Scope 
Regulation (EU) 2022/1358 
This Subpart establishes the procedure for issuing noise certificates to aircraft which conform to a type 
certificate that has been issued in accordance with this Annex.
